title: ActivationConfig
description:
The activation document: the state a client authors for one active charter (ADR-0020 D4). It is the body of PUT /activations/{activationId} and POST /activations and the config of every Activation answer. Core keeps its own files and maps them to and from this document (content alignment, not file shape).

The document is packs, selected, deactivated and languages (one kind model, IC-20): mission types, steps and agent profiles are ordinary kinds of selected and deactivated. There is no kind gate: activatedKinds and missionTypes are not part of the shape, and a write that sends either is refused (422 validation_failed, one violation per member naming its replacement, selected.mission_type for missionTypes). A document stored at schemaVersion 1 is upgraded on read (its missionTypes become selected.mission_type, every selection is kept, activatedKinds is discarded) and stored as version 2 on the next write.

One meaning for absent (ADR-0053 d10): for each selected kind, absent and [] both mean none is in force, and a list means exactly those. The two register the same document: the canonical form leaves an empty selected.<kind> out, so a client that sends [] for a kind it read as absent keeps the revision (FR-042). packs and languages keep their own absent: every configured pack, and no language filter, while languages: [] means no language. null is never a value.

Canonical form, which the service stores and answers: ids in their declared spelling; id and token lists deduplicated and sorted, except packs, which keeps merge order; an empty selected.<kind> list, and an empty selected or deactivated object, left out; lists sorted by Unicode code point; members in the order of this schema. An empty deny list is refused (422), never stored. The activation's revision is sha256: and the hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization of the canonical document.

Not in the document, by ruling (2026-10-31): per-entry provenance, context activations and applied presets. Not stored because the packs derive it: the required floor, locked artifacts, the available artifacts and the skipped report.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this document's shape: 2, the one kind model (IC-20). A document stored at version 1 is upgraded on read and stored as version 2 on the next write.

packs.description: The packs the activation builds on, in merge order: a later pack wins over an earlier one. Absent means the service's configured offering. A pack id appears once (422 activation_invalid otherwise).

selected.description: The allow lists, per kind, mission_type included. Absent means none of any kind is selected.

deactivated.description: The deny lists, per kind. Absent means no exclusion.

languages.description: The project's languages, as authored; languages core derives are not sent. Absent means no language filter; [] means no language.

ArtifactId.title: ArtifactId
ArtifactId.description: An artifact's declared id, the tail of its URN (directive:DIRECTIVE_001 has the id DIRECTIVE_001). A write may use another known spelling of the same artifact; the stored document holds the declared id (ADR-0020 D4).

ArtifactIdList.title: ArtifactIdList
ArtifactIdList.description: Artifact ids of one kind. Empty means none of the kind.

DeactivatedArtifacts.title: DeactivatedArtifacts
DeactivatedArtifacts.description: The deny lists: per activatable kind, the artifacts the user deactivated (ADR-0013). A deny entry wins over a selection and a cascade; an artifact a pack requires or locks cannot be deactivated (409). A deny entry is never stored for an unknown kind or a required or locked id (ADR-0020 D9). Absent, the activation excludes nothing.

directive.description: The directive ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

tactic.description: The tactic ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

styleguide.description: The styleguide ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

toolguide.description: The toolguide ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

paradigm.description: The paradigm ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

procedure.description: The procedure ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

agent_profile.description: The agent_profile ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

mission_step_contract.description: The mission_step_contract ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

glossary_pack.description: The glossary_pack ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

skill.description: The skill ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

anti_pattern.description: The anti_pattern ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

mission_type.description: The mission_type ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind. A mission type a pack requires or locks cannot be denied (409), as any kind.

step_enhancement.description: The step_enhancement ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind. A step enhancement a pack requires or locks cannot be denied (409), as any kind.

DeniedArtifactIdList.title: DeniedArtifactIdList
DeniedArtifactIdList.description: The deactivated ids of one kind. Never empty: a kind with no deny entry is left out of the deny list.

LanguageToken.title: LanguageToken
LanguageToken.description: A programming language as the project authored it, lower case, for example java or c#.

PackPin.title: PackPin
PackPin.description: One pack the activation builds on (ADR-0033 D6).

packId.description: The pack's id, as the service's pack registry names it.

version.description: The pack version the activation builds on, as the pack declares it (pack_version). Absent means the version the service holds; with several versions held side by side, the newest (ADR-0033 D7).

SelectedArtifacts.title: SelectedArtifacts
SelectedArtifacts.description: The allow lists: per activatable kind, mission_type included, the artifacts the activation selects. A kind that is absent selects none of the kind (ADR-0053 d10); what a pack requires or locks is in force whatever the lists hold. One property per activatable kind, so a kind outside that vocabulary is refused (422 activation_invalid).

directive.description: The directive ids. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

tactic.description: The tactic ids. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

styleguide.description: The styleguide ids. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

toolguide.description: The toolguide ids. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

paradigm.description: The paradigm ids. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

procedure.description: The procedure ids. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

agent_profile.description: The agent_profile ids. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

mission_step_contract.description: The mission_step_contract ids. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

glossary_pack.description: The glossary_pack ids. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

skill.description: The skill ids. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

anti_pattern.description: The anti_pattern ids. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

mission_type.description: The mission_type ids: the mission types the activation selects. Selecting a mission type cascades to the steps it holds. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

step_enhancement.description: The step_enhancement ids. Absent means none of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those. Selecting one puts its additions, prompt fragments included, in force (ADR-0066).

Slug.title: Slug
Slug.description: A lowercase identifier segment of a DRG URN.
